record.label: Logical qubits and spacetime cost over 500 runs
record.statement: The solution uses $Q=4{,}338$ logical qubits. Appendix G gives a spacetime cost of $229{,}357{,}900{,}876{,}653{,}900$ over all 500 runs. For gates conditioned on measurement outcomes, the paper counts $T$ gates on the most expensive outcome branch.
record.boundary: Dividing the proved upper bound on $Q\cdot\mathcal T$ by 500 gives about $4.59\times10^{14}$ per run.
